title: Visual Template Editor
summary: A visual editor for complex subscription-platform templates that never breaks the code underneath.
problem: Templates mix HTML, CSS, JavaScript, dynamic placeholders and platform scripts — any manual edit could break checkout behaviour.
solution: React/TypeScript editor with visual and code modes, a content-fields panel, desktop/mobile previews, a template library and import/export round-trips that preserve placeholders and platform-specific scripts.
result: Complex templates (countdown modals, themed offers) can be adjusted visually and saved back as drafts without hand-editing markup.
